about.title: About
about.lead: Breaking the stereotype that equates Infinity Nikki players with being bad at computers
about.bio1: I'm QianLu, known everywhere as “<brand/>” — an independent creator who collects warmth through a lens and organizes inspiration with code. I take photos, and I write code.
about.bio2: I make bite-sized computer explainers for the styling community: turning Infinity Nikki's graphics, frame rates, and crashes into step-by-step settings anyone can follow, published on Bilibili, Xiaohongshu, and more.
about.bio3: Eventually I turned that experience into open-source tools: Nikki Gallery keeps players' scattered screenshots and recordings as one local album, and FlashGaze uses AI to batch-score photos on your own machine — instead of teaching it all from scratch every time, I let the tools run themselves.
